frozen47_protocol: Finite retained-field-space unitary exp(i sum epsilon_l P*a_l*P), NOT an exact unbounded mode-pure Weyl kick.
initial_preparation_effect: Distinct projected field coordinates need not commute. A pulse nominally on one coordinate can already change another mode's physical Pi expectation at t=0. Actual initial all-mode Pi must be measured rather than presumed invariant.

comparison_definitions.calibrated_coupled_increment: final_cross_protocol_response(full)-final_cross_protocol_response(field_decoupled), equivalently the difference of temporal_response_difference values for identical initial rays

causal_scope: Large raw decoupled response may predominantly be an injected INITIAL preparation offset, not a large propagation error. Do not attribute all reduction under a new protocol to exact free propagation if the physical pulse/ray also changed.
new_IP_review_boundary: Compare exact-U0 evolution on matched old physical rays separately from new full unbounded Weyl pulse preparations. New method's bare invariance is not proof of coupled field response or photon closure.
evidence_policy: Frozen47 operator, old pulse arrays and executed captures remain unchanged. New measurements/readout label initial Pi and temporal differences explicitly; no retroactive old-state relabeling or physical rerun solely for terminology.
